name: @chbrain/khai-engine-combustion
description: khai engine content, the combustion domain: a catalog of the named phenomena of fire -- each a distinct way something burns, with its own fuel and chemistry, its physical dynamics, its sensory signature, and the paradox by which the obvious way to fight it fails or feeds it. Where the fire engine reads a place's burn regime, combustion reads the specific phenomenon, across the wildland, the compartment, the industrial plant, the made fire, and the conveyance.

khai.tagline: Combustion as process: a catalog of the named phenomena of fire -- each a distinct way something burns, with its own fuel and chemistry, physical dynamics, sensory signature, and the paradox by which the obvious way to fight it fails or feeds it. Where the fire engine reads a place's burn regime, combustion reads the specific phenomenon, across the wildland, the compartment, the industrial plant, the made fire, and the conveyance.

card.wire: Attaches at Place, on the Shown chapter -- the specific fire a place shows, named and behaving in its own way. The root (process_combustion.md) declares combustion as a catalog: the named phenomena of fire, each with its own fuel and chemistry, physical dynamics, sensory signature, and extinguishment paradox. It is the specific phenomenon, not the place's burn regime and its modes (fire's), the fire-weather that primes it (weather's), the drought that cures the fuel (hydrology's), the regrowth that follows (succession's), or the fire from below (geomorphology's). Fire reads the regime; combustion reads the type.
card.issue: A catalog over a combustion root, one member per named phenomenon, grouped by domain. The wildland domain opens it: crown is the canopy fire, grass the fast light-fuel front, chaparral the volatile-oil brush fire, peat the flameless organic-soil smoulder, duff the ground fire creeping at the combustion limit through mineral-laced forest floor, holdover the fire that overwinters and re-emerges, spotting the firebrands that leap ahead of the front, slash the heavy-residue burn, serotiny the fire-cued regeneration, coal-seam the geological fuel alight underground on a clock of decades to millennia, and wui the interface fire in which the houses themselves become the fuel. The compartment and extreme-dynamics domain follows: flashover, backdraft, rollover, thermal layering, the chimney effect, pyrolysis, the cladding fire that climbs a building's combustible envelope, the tunnel fire whose ventilation allocates the smoke, the convection column, the fire whirl, pyrocumulonimbus, firestorm, and the eruptive blow-up. The industrial and chemical domain adds the plant hazards: the pool fire, the pressurised jet, the flash fire, the vapour cloud explosion, the BLEVE, the boilover, the combustible-metal fire, lithium runaway, the dust explosion, self-heating, pyrophoric ignition, the oxidizer-fed fire, hypergolic ignition, the arc flash, the polymer fire whose smoke kills before its flame, the hydrogen fire that burns invisible and is isolated before it is ever extinguished, and the runaway reaction whose exponential heat outruns any cooling. The made-fire domain adds the fire humans light on purpose and hold to a task -- the backfire and the prescribed burn, swidden and fire-stick farming, the charcoal clamp, the forge, the blast furnace, the kiln, the incinerator, the flare, the cutting torch, the premixed burner, the pyrotechnics that mass-explode when their tested classification fails in bulk, the barbecue, the candle, and the cremation -- each read by the moment its control slips. The conveyance domain closes the catalog: fire in the vessel under way, the burning compartment that cannot be left -- the ship fire fought sealed and cooled from its boundaries, its one CO2 shot spent the moment a deck is opened and its battery cargo burning through the blanket; the aircraft fire that races the descent, the checklist the fire's ally and the runway the only extinguisher; the vehicle fire whose traction battery holds stranded energy and reignites days after the flames; and the spacecraft fire that burns without buoyancy on the ventilation's wind, in the one place whose air is all there is. Each member fixes the phenomenon's fuel, temperature, dynamics, sensory read, and the paradox by which the standard method fails or feeds it.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the engine. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so combustion reads system-wide and a fire a place shows is read as the specific phenomenon it is. The link: a place carries, under Shown, the combustion phenomenon it shows, linking one member.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; the read is judged. The kit verifies the law is declared and each place links a real phenomenon file under Shown. Whether the phenomenon is true to the place and its fuel -- the chemistry, the dynamics, the sensory signature, the paradox -- is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Then give each place whose fire is an actor the phenomenon it shows under Shown -- the crown fire in the canopy, the grass fire across the range, the peat smouldering below, the firebrands spotting ahead. Keep it the specific phenomenon and its behaviour, not the place's abstract burn regime (hand that to fire), the fire-weather (to weather), the drought (to hydrology), the regrowth (to succession), or the fire from below (to geomorphology). Read each phenomenon by its own paradox: the way the obvious method fails or feeds it.
